commits.author: Timothy Herchen <timothy.herchen@gmail.com>
commits.message:
Unroll important loops

Historically we've had issues with compilers not unrolling loops in NNUE: https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/issues/6474 , https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/pull/7251

These loops are special in that not unrolling them is always extremely bad for performance, rather than a heuristic that the compiler should guide to balance code size and instruction count. Thus, for GCC and clang, introduce `UNROLLED_FOR` that unconditionally unrolls these loops.

commits.author: Shawn Xu <xu107288696@gmail.com>
commits.message:
Update NNUE architecture to SFNNv20 and net nn-18cd32e11a9c.nnue

Combination of two changes:
* An additional two keys to the LayerStack selection, factorized in training, that results in 192 unique configurations. The keys are
    * Whether pawns occupy the full board, one half, or none
    * Whether at least one side has >=2 non-pawn pieces (officers)
* Lower LR for non-factorizer K32Q2 and Threats input weights.

Both changes have been individually tested. Over half of the 192 LayerStack buckets are impossible to encounter in any reasonable game and are not present in learnable quantities in the training data. These buckets are dynamically pruned pre-training. QAT warmups were added to reduce the impact of init noise. It is not expected to bring any elo gain.

commits.author: Robert Nurnberg @ elitebook <28635489+robertnurnberg@users.noreply.github.com>
commits.message:
Fix final PV output when Skill Level is enabled

If Skill Level is enabled, master may not always show the correct final PV (and eval) corresponding to the chosen bestmove. This PR fixes this by setting `uciPvSent` to false if a swap of rootmoves took place.

Example:
```
setoption name Skill Level value 0
go depth 10
```
Master:
```
info depth 10 seldepth 11 multipv 1 score cp 23 nodes 13995 nps 424090 hashfull 2 tbhits 0 time 33 pv e2e4 e7e5 g1f3 b8c6 d2d4 e5d4 f3d4
bestmove d2d3 ponder d7d5
```
Patch:
```
info depth 10 seldepth 11 multipv 1 score cp 23 nodes 13995 nps 311000 hashfull 2 tbhits 0 time 45 pv e2e4 e7e5 g1f3 b8c6 d2d4 e5d4 f3d4
info depth 10 seldepth 10 multipv 1 score cp 18 nodes 13995 nps 311000 hashfull 2 tbhits 0 time 45 pv d2d4 g8f6 g1f3 d7d5 c2c4 c7c6 e2e3
bestmove d2d4 ponder g8f6
```

closes https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/pull/7267

No functional change
commits.subject: Fix final PV output when Skill Level is enabled
